verdict.rationale: Evidence describes an MCP server for AI-assistant access to list audits/evidence requests and add comments/attachments (docs-19, docs-20, docs-28), plus auditor-vetted native integrations, but there is no documented public/developer API for pushing custom evidence or test results from arbitrary systems not covered by the integration catalog. MCP is scoped to assistant read/comment actions inside the workspace, not a general-purpose evidence-push API for custom development.
